# VictorStack: engineering notes by Victor Jimenez

> Victor Jimenez is a Senior Product Engineer with 13+ years of full-stack web development. This blog holds his engineering notes on React, Next.js, TypeScript, PHP, Node and Python, integrations, release engineering, performance, security and accessibility.

## About the author

- Name: Victor Jimenez
- Role: Senior Product Engineer
- Work: full-stack web products from the browser to the database
- Focus areas: architecture and integrations (payments and billing, OAuth and SSO, CRM), CI/CD and release verification, performance and technical SEO, security and accessibility, AI-assisted engineering and automation, technical leadership
- Specialties: Drupal and WordPress

## How posts are written

- Posts dated before October 2026 were first drafted by an automated content pipeline. In October 2026 the blog was cut to its evergreen playbooks and tools, and each remaining post was rewritten to Victor's voice guide. The rewrite kept the original code, diagrams, numbers and links and added no new facts.
- Posts dated October 2026 or later are written from Victor's own notes and approved by him before publishing.

## Topics

- Product engineering: React, Next.js, TypeScript and Node from the browser to the database
- Web platform, performance, accessibility and technical SEO
- AI-assisted engineering and agents in practice
- Release engineering, testing and quality
- Integrations, payments, identity and security
- Technical leadership and process that fits the team
- Drupal and WordPress
